heroBody: Your generosity supports worship, discipleship, youth ministry, outreach, and the work of sharing the hope of Jesus in Rapid City.
cardTitle: A simple, secure way to give.
cardBody: Planned payment options include Apple Pay, Google Pay, card, and bank transfer.
safetyNote: No payment information is collected on this preview.
scripture: Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give.
waysIntro: Choose the option that works best for you. Every gift is handled with care and accountability.
onlineText: Make a one-time or recurring gift through our secure giving partner once setup is complete.
inPersonText: Give during Sunday worship using the designated giving box. Checks may be made payable to TELL Church.
otherText: For stock, planned giving, or other non-cash gifts, contact the church office before sending funds.
helpText: Church contact information will be added here before online giving launches.
